a: Chapter 16. Of Faith and Good Works: of Their Reward and of
We believe with our hearts and confess with our mouths
x: to be enrolled among His household servants
…watered garden, to have communion here with the saints, that they may be made to be partakers of their inheritance in the kingdom of God
…God has given them, to be under His heavenly conduct and government, to lead their lives in this walled sheepfold, and watered garden
In the same book, the church is compared sometimes to a garden, sometimes to an orchard
